name: noclip
description: Nothing in the display blocks the player: walk through walls, enemies and everything else.
evidence: $290B scan_display_column_for_blocking_byte reads (display_pointer),Y and reports carry set for any byte that is neither zero nor $C0, so obstruction is decided by what is drawn rather than by object coordinates
both movement routines call it before committing a step, and only a carry-clear return reaches the step itself

entities are XOR-drawn into the same display the scan reads, which is why an enemy blocks the player exactly as a wall does and why disabling the collision action at $2B88 removed the damage but not the obstruction
the routine already ends CLC then RTS at $292D, so returning that immediately is the answer it gives for a clear column
qualifications: this removes every obstruction, not just enemies: the scan cannot distinguish an enemy pixel from a wall pixel, so walls, floors and ledges stop blocking too
gravity still applies, so the player will fall through floors unless the jet boots are held
the marker scans that read the same display for other purposes are untouched, so doors and items still respond
